concerns.text: FR-004 specifies that the pruning heuristic must remove a skill **iff** (usage_count == 0) **and** (min_cosine_similarity_to_any_other_skill_in_library < 0.70). The task description for T007 instead states removal when **max_cosine_similarity_to_any_other_skill_in_library > 0.70** and adds an extra ground‑truth check, which contradicts the functional requirement and weakens the intended intervention. This violates the spec and the constitution’s requirement‑preservation principle.
